title: Word Building & Linking Words
description: Question words (who, what, when, where, how, why), possessive adjectives and pronouns with the genitive 's, reflexive pronouns, compound adjectives, compound nouns, the gerund and the spelling of -ing forms, and the linking words of cause and consequence (because, so, therefore, as a result, that's why) and of contrast (while, whereas)
sources: Proceed with English — 9th Year Basic Education, Student's Book 141906 & Activity Book 141907 (CNP): Module 1 Lesson 1, SB p. 7–9 (question words); Module 1 Lesson 3, SB p. 14–19, AB p. 17 (compound adjectives); Module 1 Lesson 5, SB p. 24–27, AB p. 26–27 (while / whereas); Module 2 Lesson 1, SB p. 30–33, AB p. 38–39 (possessive pronouns, the genitive); Module 2 Lesson 2, SB p. 34–39, AB p. 44 (reflexive pronouns); Module 3 Lesson 1, SB p. 55–59, AB p. 71 (linkers of cause and consequence); Module 3 Lesson 5, SB p. 75–78, AB p. 90 (compound nouns); Module 4 Lesson 5, SB p. 94–97, AB p. 120 (the gerund, spelling of -ing forms); Grammar review, SB p. 146–155
